full_judgment: 8. Neither the petitioner nor the respondent No. 1 adduced any evidence at the hearing of the Election Tribunal case although the burden of proof was lying upon the petitioner to call for the relevant papers from the office of Returning Officer/Election Commissioner and from the concerned Bank who classified the petitioner as a loan defaulter. Since no evidence has been adduce, I need to record the submission of the learned Advocates in detail for lawful disposal of the case.
